text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter said it was maintaining its outperform rating on Brazilian state oil firm Petrobras.
-- also said it was maintaining its 12-month price target of 340 reais per 1,000 shares.

-- "After rising as much as 80 percent this year and 30 percent in the last month, Petrobras' selloff this week is not surprising and provides a buying opportunity," said analysts Lloyd Byrne and Hillary Peruzzi in a report.

-- "We continue to recommend the equity and believe yesterday's pullback is an opportunity to build positions. Moreover a large measure of the near term risk can be mitigated over the next 18-months by the inflow of international capital and the projected increase in crude oil production," they said.
-- Petrobras preferred was up 2.14 percent at 287 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
